steamify.options.title: Humours of the Handheld Engine
steamify.haptic.mining.tooltip: A faint tick at each crack stage while breaking a block
steamify.haptic.fishing.tooltip: A buzz the moment a fish takes the bait
steamify.haptic.explosion.tooltip: Rumble from nearby explosions, stronger the closer they are
steamify.haptic.thunder.tooltip: Rumble when lightning strikes, stronger the closer it is
steamify.haptic.bow.tooltip: Ticks that quicken as a bow draws and a press at full draw. Also clicks when a crossbow loads or a trident is ready
steamify.haptic.shield.tooltip: A thud when thy shield stops a hit
steamify.haptic.heartbeat.tooltip: A heartbeat at 3 hearts and below, faster the lower thou goest
steamify.haptic.trigger.tooltip: Pulling a trigger past its press point
steamify.haptic.rightPad.tooltip: Light ticks while thy thumb moves on the right touchstone
steamify.haptic.hotbar.tooltip: A tick each time the left touchstone picks a new hotbar slot
steamify.haptic.footsteps.tooltip: Each step on the ground, alternating left and right
steamify.haptic.damage.tooltip: Taking damage, harder the bigger the hit
steamify.haptic.landing.tooltip: Hitting the ground after a fall, stronger the further thou fellest
steamify.haptic.flight.tooltip: Low wind rumble while gliding or flying, pulsing faster the faster thou goest
steamify.haptic.falling.tooltip: Sharp rattle while falling, faster the faster thou fallest
steamify.calibrate.title: Attune Thy Gyroscope
steamify.calibrate.hint: Put the handheld engine down on a flat surface and do not touch it
steamify.calibrate.waiting: Waiting for the handheld engine to be still...
steamify.calibrate.noGyro: No handheld engine with a gyro connected
steamify.calibrate.button.tooltip: Measures the gyro's resting drift with the handheld engine lying still. Redo it if aiming drifts or slow turns feel off
steamify.calibrate.prompt.title: Wilt thou attune thy gyroscope?
steamify.calibrate.prompt: Gyro aiming feels best once the handheld engine hath been calibrated. It takes a few seconds with the handheld engine lying on a flat surface.
steamify.options.sets.tooltip: Extra layers of handheld engine binds, switched on by a button, a grip, a staff touch or a staff pushed to its edge
steamify.sets.title: Companies of Action
steamify.sets.add.tooltip: A layer of binds on top of the normal ones. It only changes the binds thou settest in it
steamify.sets.name: Name
steamify.sets.trigger.tooltip: Press, then press the button or combo, touch a grip or staff, or push a staff to its edge. Already holding a grip? Let go and touch it again. Hold B for a second to cancel. Right-press (or LT) to pick from a list
steamify.sets.enter.tooltip: Pressed once when the set switches on
steamify.sets.enter.title: %s: On Enter
steamify.sets.exit.tooltip: Pressed once when the set switches off
steamify.sets.exit.title: %s: On Exit
steamify.sets.hold.tooltip: Held down the whole time the set is on, and let go when it switches off. E.g. a zoom key, on a set triggered by R5
steamify.sets.hold.title: %s: Hold While On
steamify.sets.mode.tooltip: Hold: on while the trigger is held. Toggle: each press switches it. While Released: on while the trigger is NOT held, e.g. letting go of a grip
steamify.sets.where.tooltip: In Bills of Fare: the set's binds work on bill of fare screens like the inventory, o'er the normal bill of fare controls on the buttons they use. Handy for a mod's inventory keys
steamify.sets.places.tooltip: Press while in a singleplayer realm or on a court to add it, again to remove it. From the title stage: clear. With realms set, the set is only on there. With no trigger or wares, 'tis always on there
steamify.sets.gyro.tooltip: Gyro while this set is on. Unchanged leaves it to the sets below, normally on while the right pad is touched
steamify.battery.low.title: Thy handheld engine's vigour fades
steamify.battery.low: But %s%% remaineth. Give it succour anon
steamify.sets.items.tooltip: Press while holding an item to add it, again to remove it. With an empty hand: clear. With wares set, the set is only on while thou holdest one of them (and its button trigger, if it hath one, is active)
steamify.sets.tunes.tooltip: Staff, pad and gyro speed, deadzone, Steady Aim and aim assist while this set is on
steamify.sets.tunes.title: %s: Sensitivity
steamify.sets.tunes.slider.tooltip: All the way left: unchanged, the normal Handheld Engine Humours value applies
steamify.sets.binds.tooltip: Controls stage for this set. Grey binds come from the normal layout. Escape to unbind in this set, Backspace to go back to the normal bind
steamify.sets.editing: Editing action set: %s  (Escape to unbind, Backspace to use the normal bind)
steamify.option.hotbar.strip.tooltip: OFF: a 3x3 grid in the middle of the stage, slots 1-3 on the top row. ON: the pad's width maps to the hotbar, left edge slot 1, right edge slot 9
steamify.option.hotbar.gridSpot.tooltip: Center: the grid pops up while the left pad is touched. A corner: the grid stays there in place of the normal hotbar. Not used with Strip Layout
steamify.option.hud.showBinds.tooltip: Shows button hints in the bottom right corner for what you can do right now, like Bedrock Edition
steamify.debug.title: Debug Shortcuts
steamify.option.look.stickSpeed.tooltip: How fast the right staff turns the camera
steamify.option.look.padSpeed.tooltip: How far the camera turns per swipe on the right touchstone
steamify.option.look.gyro.tooltip: Camera rotation per handheld engine rotation. 1.0x turns the camera exactly as far as thou turnest the handheld engine
steamify.option.look.gyroAccel.tooltip: More feel for quick turns. At 100%, turning the controller quickly turns the sight up to twice as far, while slow moves keep the usual feel for a true aim
steamify.option.look.stickDeadzone.toolt: How far a staff must move ere it counts. Raise it if the camera or player drifts on its own
steamify.option.menu.cursorSpeed.tooltip: How fast the right staff and touchstone move the cursor in bills of fare
steamify.option.look.invertY.tooltip: Flips up and down for staff, touchstone and gyro camera control
steamify.option.gyro.steadyAim.tooltip: Lowers gyro sensitivity while drawing a bow, charging a crossbow, readying a trident, using a spyglass or holding a loaded crossbow
How much Steady Aim lowers gyro sensitivity
steamify.option.aim.assist.tooltip: Slows turning while thy crosshair is on a knave in reach and gently pulls toward it while thou steerest. Handheld Engine only, ne'er affects the mouse
steamify.option.aim.assistStrength.toolt: How strongly aim assist slows and pulls
steamify.option.aim.assistSingleplayerOn: Turns aim assist off on courts and LAN realms
steamify.onboard.title: The Steamify Prologue
steamify.onboard.page2: This can be changed later in humours
steamify.onboard.page3: Gyro aiming feels best once the handheld engine hath been calibrated. It takes a few seconds with the handheld engine lying on a flat surface.
steamify.onboard.gyro.none: This handheld engine hath no gyro, so there be naught to calibrate
steamify.option.haptics.master.tooltip: Scales ev'ry haptic effect at once. The individual sliders below set each effect relative to this
steamify.onboard.page4: Try the right staff, the right touchstone, and the gyro while thy thumb rests on the touchstone
steamify.onboard.look.noPads: Try the right stick, and the gyro if your controller has one
steamify.onboard.page5: Which layouts should the on-stage scribe's board switch between?
steamify.bind.tooltip: Press, then press a button or combo, push a staff to its edge or swipe a touchstone. Right-press (or LT) to pick long press, double press and other press types
steamify.bind.title: %s: Handheld Engine Binds
steamify.bind.combo.tooltip: Press, then press the new button or combo, push a staff to its edge or swipe a touchstone. Right-press (or LT) to pick from a list. Escape to remove this bind
steamify.gesture.regular.tooltip: On for as long as thou holdest the buttons
steamify.gesture.short.tooltip: Taps when thou lettest go ere the long press time. Pair it with a Long Press on the same buttons to give them two actions
steamify.gesture.long.tooltip: Turns on once thou hast held for the long press time, and stays on until thou lettest go
steamify.gesture.double.tooltip: Turns on with a quick second press and stays on while thou holdest it. A Short Press on the same buttons waits out the double press time first
steamify.gesture.start.tooltip: Taps the moment thou pressest, even when the same buttons also have a long or double press
steamify.gesture.release.tooltip: Taps when thou lettest go, however long thou held
steamify.option.binds.longPress.tooltip: How long to hold for a Long Press. Letting go sooner counts as a Short Press
steamify.option.binds.doublePress.toolti: How anon the second press of a Double Press hath to come
steamify.option.binds.stickEdge.tooltip: How far a staff hath to be pushed for its edge inputs (L Stick Up, L Stick Edge...), from the center (0%%) to all the way (100%%)
steamify.option.binds.padEdge.tooltip: How far from the center thy finger hath to be for a touchstone's edge inputs (L Pad Up, L Pad Edge...)
steamify.option.binds.swipeStep.tooltip: How far thy finger travels per press of a swipe input (L Pad Swipe Up...), in percent of the pad's width. Lower scrolls faster
steamify.steam.toast.body: It may double thy commands. Close Steam.
steamify.steam.warning: Steam doth run: its manner of the engine may double thy commands
steamify.steam.warning.fix: Close Steam whilst thou playest with Steamify
steamify.picker.hint: Pick one, or several to hold together
steamify.profiles.title: Guises
steamify.profiles.button.tooltip: Whole setups to switch between with one press: binds, action sets and these humours. Each handheld engine remembers the guise thou last used with it and switches back to it when it connects. Gyro calibration is shared by all of them
steamify.profiles.add.tooltip: Adds a transcribe of the current guise to the list. Press it to switch to it
steamify.option.look.padFriction.tooltip: How quickly a flick on the right touchstone spins down. Higher stops sooner
steamify.share.invalid: The clipboard doth not hold aught copied from Steamify
steamify.profiles.copy.tooltip: Copies this guise to the clipboard as one line of text to share. Gyro calibration is not included, but realm names and court addresses in its action sets are
steamify.profiles.paste.tooltip: Adds a guise from text copied with Transcribe, and switches to it
steamify.sets.copy.tooltip: Copies this set to the clipboard as one line of text to share
steamify.sets.paste.tooltip: Adds a set from text copied with Transcribe Set
steamify.profiles.name.tooltip: Name of the active guise (the highlighted one)
steamify.profiles.lock.tooltip: Keeps the handheld engine thou art using tied to this guise. Switching guises still works, but the handheld engine comes back to this one the next time thou pickest it up
steamify.profiles.controllers.tooltip: Choose thou which guise each handheld engine doth wear, without taking it in hand
steamify.controllers.title: Handheld Engines
steamify.controllers.none: No handheld engines as yet. One shall appear here once it doth join
steamify.controllers.forget.tooltip: Striketh this engine from the list. It shall receive a new guise when next it joineth
steamify.option.gyro.playerSpace.tooltip: ON: to turn left or right followeth the horizon howe'er thou holdest thy handheld engine. OFF: only turning it about its own upright axis doth turn
